set.body: Add a PullbackProgram-style IR that lowers a complete SpatialGraph route from final target samples back to a Field root, plus a registry of typed morphism compiler capabilities. Separate route resolution, coordinate pullback, support planning, sparse operator construction, and execution. Acceptance: no central catch-all match is required to add a morphism compiler; identity routes are zero-work; compiler and route fingerprints are stable cache inputs; unsupported edge classes and incompatible domain transitions are explicit SpatialError cases; registry and lowering tests run on JVM and JS.
set.title: Spatial pullback compiler IR and extensible morphism compiler registry
